bullets_en: Khairthabad by-election to test BJP’s performance in Hyderabad.
Revanth Reddy recalls ABVP past, advises Modi ahead of 2029 polls.
‘Special Enrichment’ programme expanded to 445 schools in Keralam.
J&K Bureaucrats Oppose Statehood Resolution In Rare Letter To Assembly Speaker.
Congress Plans To Enrol 7 Lakh Graduate Voters.
bullets_ur: Khairthabad by-election BJP ki Hyderabad mein karkardagi ko parakhega.
Revanth Reddy ne ABVP ke maazi ko yaad kiya, Modi ko 2029 ke intikhabat se pehle mashwara diya.
'Special Enrichment' programme Keralam ke 445 schools tak phela diya gaya.
J&K ke bureaucrats ne Assembly Speaker ko nayaab khat mein Statehood resolution ki mukhalifat ki.
Congress ne 7 lakh graduate voters ko register karne ka mansooba banaya.
